$comment: The widget's shared parts (checked by ci/reuse.mjs). Something new (a module, an animation) is listed here on purpose, with what it is, in the same pull request, so it's a choice made in review and not a copy that slipped in. Before adding one, look for the part that already does it.

modules.anchoring.ts: where a pin sits on the page and how it finds its spot again
modules.components.ts: which component drew an element (React, Vue, Svelte), for a pin; its own file (public/_lab/components.js), loaded only on a page a framework drew
modules.composer.ts: the text box for a comment or a reply, and its send button
modules.frame.ts: a page inside a board's frame: draws nothing, binds nothing; keeps live updates and passes keys to the board
modules.hold.ts: a dev server's reload waits while a sheet is open
modules.pinhold.ts: pins the browser holds on their element with CSS anchor positioning (flag native): no script on scroll
modules.ink.ts: drawing pins (hold D and drag): the lines as they are drawn and over a saved drawing, and the drawing as an area comment
modules.draw.ts: what a drawing's lines read as (circled, arrow, underlined…); its own file (public/_lab/draw.js), loaded when D is first pressed
modules.list.ts: the list of pins (a sheet on phones)
modules.live.ts: the live stream: listening badge, mode, who is heard
modules.messages.ts: one message in a thread or the chat
modules.motion.ts: pause and ¼ speed for what moves on the page (videos, animations), the controls beside each, and a pin's moment on it
modules.actions.ts: action buttons: a data-lab-action element on the page opens a comment with its words, the agent acts on it
modules.sections.ts: the section bar: each section with a heading, current one filled, new and updated marked, read kept per person in the lab
modules.sheets.ts: THE drawer: every sheet on a phone (handle, swipe down, dimmed page, keyboard fit, back closes). Any new panel on a phone uses it.
modules.stick.ts: a message list that stays at its newest while it shrinks (keyboard up) until you scroll back; used by the chat and a thread
modules.switcher.ts: labs & pages (⌘K): a box on a computer, one of the sheets on a phone; built as its own file (public/_lab/switcher.js), loaded on the first ⌘K or ⋯ open
modules.switcher.css: the styles of switcher.ts, which brings them with it
modules.trial.ts: a question's choices tried in the sentence: the differing words swapped in place, the block's height held, the page put back exactly

$where: Files that may own a part: the drawer's gestures and keyboard fit live in sheets.ts (comments.js wires them up).

values.$comment: Values written into a rule on purpose (ci/reuse.mjs part 6). Everything else comes from a token. Add one here with why, in the pull request that needs it.

radii.14px 14px 14px 2px: the pin: a teardrop, its tail at the bottom left (28 px)
radii.11px 11px 11px 2px: the pin glyph in the bar: the same teardrop at 22 px
radii.18px 18px 18px 6px: the ring around a pin: the teardrop 4 px out, concentric
radii.2px: the grab handle: a 4 px tall pill
radii.8px: the switch in the ⋯ menu: a 16 px tall pill
radii.12px: the switch knob: a 12 px circle

motion.0ms !important: reduced motion: every animation runs at once

code.anchoring.ts: rgb(1, 2, 3): a sentinel colour to tell whether the page set one, never drawn
code.comments.js: rgba(52, 199, 89, .3): the selection highlight, drawn in the page document where the widget tokens are not
